rating.verdict: A friendly lifegain-and-drain deck that's easy to learn: attack with flyers, gain life, and watch the triggers add up. No Game Changers, tutors or combos, so it fits Bracket 2 (Core).
strengths: Lots of flyers that are hard to block
Lifegain keeps you safe against aggressive decks
Each life gained or lost triggers drains and pumps (Lunar Convocation, Starseer Mentor, Moonstone Harbinger)
weaknesses: Many small creatures: board wipes hurt
Slow to close against decks with big lifegain of their own
Few ways to deal with an opponent's combo

wins: Fly over with bats. Every bat attack gains life with Zoraline out, and that lifegain fuels drains: Lunar Convocation, Bastion of Remembrance and Starseer Mentor chip opponents down while Ajani's Pridemate and Essence Channeler grow.
plan: A cheap lifelinker or lifegain creature: Ruin-Lurker Bat, Soul Warden, Starscape Cleric, Deep-Cavern Bat.
Cast Zoraline. She attacks in the air with vigilance; pay WB and 2 life to bring back a cheap permanent from your graveyard.
More flyers and payoffs: Moonrise Cleric, Star Charter, Lunar Convocation, Glidedive Duo.
Attack with the flock every turn. Starseer Mentor and Sunscorch Regent close the game while the drains finish whoever is low.
keys: Flying, vigilance; you gain 1 life whenever a bat attacks, and she can return a permanent with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard.
If you gained life this turn, each opponent loses 1 at your end step.
At your end step, if you gained or lost life, an opponent loses 3 unless they sacrifice or discard.
Gaining or losing life on your turn gives all your bats +1/+0 and deathtouch.
Grows every time you gain life.
tips: Zoraline's ability costs WB and 2 life, and paying life also counts as "lost life this turn" for Star Charter, Starlit Soothsayer and Starseer Mentor.
Soul Warden and Soul's Attendant trigger on every creature entering, including your opponents'.
Bats aren't the only flyers here: angels and birds attack in the air too, but only bats trigger Zoraline's lifegain.
Sun Titan and Zoraline can bring back cheap creatures that died.
mulligan: Keep 3 lands with both colors and a 1- or 2-drop. Hands with Lunar Convocation and early creatures are great.
